name: Export Variable Products
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
WooCommerce is an awesome eCommerce plugin that allows you to sell anything. This plugin helps you to export the variations of a variable product to an Excel (.xlsx) sheet, edit prices, SKUs, dimensions and attributes in your favourite spreadsheet editor, and import the file back.

Features

  • Export and Import buttons right on the variable product edit screen.
  • Exports parent id, variation id, slug, SKU, regular and sale price, weight, length, width, height and every variation attribute.
  • Safe import: only .xlsx files are accepted, every row is validated, and rows with problems are skipped and listed in a clear summary.
  • Only the variations of the product you are editing can be changed by the file.
  • Translations: German, Spanish and French.

Premium features (plug and play, available with the premium copy)

  • More columns: stock, backorders, tax class, shipping class, description, status, virtual and sale schedule.
  • Bulk export of several variable products from the Products list.

  • Bulk import for many products from a single file.

  • Author: Fahad Mahmood

  • Project URI: http://androidbubble.com/blog/wordpress/plugins/export-variable-products

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open any variable product. The Import and Export buttons appear next to the page title.
sections.faq:
How to use this plugin?

Open any WooCommerce variable product, you will see the export button on product edit page.

In which format data will be exported?

This plugin export data in an excel sheet (.xlsx).

How to import product?

There is an Import button with Export button on edit page of WooCommerce variable product. Click Import button and browse file to import. Use a file that was exported from the same product and do not change the parent_id and id columns.

Why was a row not imported?

After the import a summary shows every row with a problem, for example an invalid price, a duplicate SKU, or an attribute value that does not exist on the parent product. Rows with a problem are skipped completely, the other rows are still imported.

Which PHP extension is required?

The ZipArchive extension (php-zip), which almost every host provides.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
  • Security: capability checks for export and import, stricter nonce and input validation, uploaded files are parsed from PHP’s temporary file instead of being stored, import values are validated and saved through WooCommerce, removed the public error log file and a reflected script injection in the admin header.
  • Import summary with updated / unchanged / failed counts and an error list, shown after the import instead of a log file.
  • Usability: file type check, confirmation before importing, busy buttons, file name display, Cancel button, clearer settings page.
  • Fixed export columns when variations use different attributes.
  • Translations are now loaded; the plugin is compatible with WooCommerce HPOS.
  • Scripts and styles load only where they are needed and use the plugin version for caching.
  • Premium directory prepared (extra columns, bulk export, bulk import).

1.2.6

  • Version updated with the improved security checklist reviewed. [08/02/2024]
